questions.question: What must be completed before you can obtain a copy of your driving record from the DMV?
choices: The Driver Privacy Protection Act Request Form (DL-DPPA-I)
questions.explanation: The Driver Privacy Protection Act Request Form (DL-DPPA-I) must be completed before your driving record can be obtained. The form is available at DMV Headquarters and on the DMV website.
questions.sourceQuote: The Driver Privacy Protection Act Request Form (DL-DPPA-I), available at DMV Headquarters and on the DMV website

questions.question: What is the fee for a certified copy of a North Carolina driving record?
questions.explanation: A certified copy of a driving record costs $18 and is available online. The non-certified records cost $12.75.
questions.sourceQuote: $18 for certified copy of record (available online)

questions.question: What is required before you can title or register a vehicle in North Carolina?
questions.explanation: A North Carolina driver license is required prior to titling or registering a vehicle in this state.
questions.sourceQuote: A North Carolina driver license is required prior to titling/registering a vehicle in this State.

questions.question: The registration card for a vehicle must be:
choices: mailed to the DMV each year
kept in the vehicle at all times
stored with the certificate of title
questions.explanation: The registration card must be kept in the vehicle at all times and must always be available to show a law enforcement officer upon request.
questions.sourceQuote: The registration card must be kept in the vehicle at all times

questions.question: Which of these is prohibited on a vehicle in North Carolina?
choices: A validation sticker on the license plate
An expiration decal on the plate
A registration card in the vehicle
questions.explanation: Plastic license plate covers are prohibited under General Statute 20-63g.
questions.sourceQuote: Plastic license plate covers are prohibited. GS 20-63g.

questions.question: Within how many days of moving within North Carolina must a license or ID holder update their physical address with the DMV?
questions.explanation: Within 60 days of moving within North Carolina, a license or ID holder must update their physical address with the DMV and get a duplicate license or ID.
questions.sourceQuote: Within 60 days of moving within North Carolina, a license or ID holder must update their physical address with the DMV

questions.question: For a new vehicle, which document serves as the official transfer document?
questions.explanation: For new vehicles, the manufacturer's certificate of origin is the official transfer document required as proof of ownership.
questions.sourceQuote: For new vehicles, the manufacturer's certificate of origin is the official transfer document

questions.question: You purchase a used vehicle that has already been registered. What must you present when registering it?
choices: A notarized bill of sale only
The certificate of title properly assigned by the former owner
questions.explanation: For a used vehicle that has already been registered, you must present the certificate of title properly assigned by the former owner.
questions.sourceQuote: must present the certificate of title properly assigned by the former owner

questions.question: Which situation allows a valid out-of-state driver license to be accepted for a vehicle registration in North Carolina?
choices: Military active duty stationed in North Carolina
Living in North Carolina for 10 years
Paying the registration fee in cash
questions.explanation: Out-of-state licenses or IDs may be accepted with documentation such as military active duty stationed in North Carolina, school enrollment in North Carolina, or a vehicle garaged in the state for a minimum of six months.
questions.sourceQuote: Valid driver licenses or identification cards issued by other states may be accepted for vehicle registrations

questions.question: What is the minimum liability insurance required for injuries to any one person in a crash in North Carolina?
questions.explanation: The minimum amount of liability insurance required is $30,000 for injuries to any one person in a crash.
questions.sourceQuote: $30,000 for injuries to any one person in a crash

questions.question: If the DMV is notified that an owner is operating a vehicle without proper liability insurance, the license plate could be revoked for how long?
questions.explanation: The license plate could be revoked for 30 days unless proof of continuous insurance coverage is provided.
questions.sourceQuote: could be revoked for 30 days unless proof of continuous insurance coverage is provided

questions.question: Does North Carolina honor a grace period for lapsed liability insurance?
choices: No, North Carolina does not honor a grace period
Yes, a six month grace period
questions.explanation: North Carolina does not honor a grace period. A grace period is an agreement between the insured and the insurance company only.
questions.sourceQuote: North Carolina does not honor a grace period.

questions.question: To avoid a fine or penalty, what should you do before terminating or canceling liability insurance on a vehicle?
choices: Surrender the vehicle's valid license plate
questions.explanation: Surrender a vehicle's valid license plate prior to the termination or cancellation of liability insurance to avoid a fine or penalty.
questions.sourceQuote: surrender a vehicle's valid license plate prior to the termination or cancellation of liability insurance

questions.question: All self-propelled vehicles must receive a safety or safety and emission inspection within how many days prior to the registration expiration to renew their registration?
questions.explanation: Within 90 days prior to the registration expiration, all self-propelled vehicles are required to receive a safety or safety and emission inspection to renew their registration.
questions.sourceQuote: Within 90 days prior to the registration expiration

questions.question: When ownership of a vehicle is transferred, the reassignment on the certificate of title must be made in the presence of whom?
questions.explanation: Reassignment of ownership is made using section A on side two of the certificate of title, and it must be made in the presence of a Notary Public for the transfer to be valid.
questions.sourceQuote: the reassignment must be made in the presence of a Notary Public

questions.question: License plates can be transferred from one vehicle to another of the same category provided that:
choices: both vehicles are the same model year
the vehicles are registered in different states
ownership is in the same name and insurance coverage has been continuous
a new inspection is completed within 30 days
questions.explanation: Plates can be transferred between vehicles of the same category if ownership is in the same name and insurance coverage has been continuous.
questions.sourceQuote: License plates can be transferred from one vehicle to another of the same category

questions.question: How long after the application and fee are received by the DMV can a duplicate title be issued?
questions.explanation: A duplicate title cannot be issued until 15 days after the application and fee are received by the DMV.
questions.sourceQuote: A duplicate title cannot be issued until 15 days after the application and fee are received by the DMV

questions.question: Under the Tag & Tax Together program, how are the license tag renewal and the vehicle property tax paid?
choices: Only at the county tax office
questions.explanation: The Tag & Tax Together program requires one payment for both bills, and both must be paid in full to renew a vehicle's annual registration.
questions.sourceQuote: The “Tag & Tax Together” program requires one payment for both bills.

questions.question: A vehicle that fails inspection is entitled to be re-inspected at the same station within how many days without paying another inspection fee?
questions.explanation: A vehicle that fails inspection may be re-inspected at the same station within 60 days without paying another inspection fee.
questions.sourceQuote: A vehicle that fails inspection is entitled to be re-inspected at the same station within 60 days

questions.question: Vehicles with less than 70,000 miles and within the three most recent model years will receive which type of inspection?
questions.explanation: Vehicles with less than 70,000 miles and within the three most recent model years will receive a safety only inspection.
questions.sourceQuote: Vehicles with less than 70,000 miles and within the “three most recent model years” will receive a safety only inspection

questions.question: What is the minimum allowable light transmittance for after-factory tinted windows in North Carolina?
questions.explanation: The allowable light transmittance for tinted windows is no less than 35%.
questions.sourceQuote: The allowable light transmittance for tinted windows is no less than 35%.

questions.question: Vehicles with after-factory window tinting are charged what additional fee as part of the vehicle inspection?
questions.explanation: Vehicles with after-factory window tinting are charged an additional fee of $10 as part of the vehicle inspection.
questions.sourceQuote: Vehicles with after-factory window tinting will be charged an additional fee of $10 as part of the vehicle inspection
